scene: The orrery reveals a secret transit balcony.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view of a cliffside transit balcony. On the far left, a silver monorail car waits with doors open. To the left, a red pedal rickshaw sits empty. The elderly East Asian player in blue cap and orange cardigan stands centre with his cane. On the right, a blue water taxi floats.
shown: a sleek suspended monorail car idling at an open gate far left
a red pedal rickshaw waiting quietly beside the player on the left
a blue canal water taxi moored at a dock on the right
